scope: AUTH_STATE_CHANGED receiver ordering in useAuth; no auth transport, verifier, token, or role contract change
confirmed_cause: The receiver treated a null-user broadcast as authoritative and cleared its account synchronously. A delayed sign-out notice could therefore replace a newer verified session already committed in storage.

class_census.delayed_negative_after_newer_sign_in: RED on pre-fix source: settled account became guest; repaired by rehydrating from canonical storage
